stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: 18 pts tells the story: Mike Bradley is top of the table while the rest scrap for a spot in the eight.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Robert Hartwig wore the Coolangatta & Tweed Heads Golf C colours proudly and played the course the right way.

stories.title: One-Point Parade
stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 7, 8 & 9 - sticking to the 1-point script

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 8, 3-pointer on hole 9 - that's better

stories.title: Going Rogue
stories.detail: Back-to-back on holes 2 & 3 - the field is on notice

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 3 & 4 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 1, 2 & 3

stories.title: Hero to Zero
stories.detail: 3-pointer then a wipe on holes 2 & 3 - feast then famine

stories.title: Perfectly Mediocre
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers straight - one point at a time, every time

stories.title: Technical Difficulties
stories.detail: 3 wipes on holes 2, 3 & 4 - please stand by

stories.title: The Phoenix
stories.detail: Wipe then 3-pointer on holes 1 & 2 - drama then redemption

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: 5th down to 13th for Desmond Mullins, the fade of a team that used all its interchange early.
